name: agentic-workflow-essentials
description: RT Coding Essentials — Cursor plugin for a phase-gated multi-agent pipeline. Install the plugin; optional setup.mjs still copies files into a repo for cloud agents.

scripts.check: node --check setup.mjs && node --check scripts/update-marketplace-cache.mjs && for f in rt-coding-essentials/scripts/*.mjs rt-coding-essentials/scripts/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; for (const p of ['.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json','rt-coding-essentials/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json','rt-coding-essentials/mcp.json','rt-coding-essentials/hooks/hooks.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));"
